{"id":1860773420,"question_id":4162,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"7 months","timestamp":1766245460,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"41 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1860773420/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Minimum Number of Operations to Have Distinct Elements","memory":"186.1 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    int minOperations(vector<int>& nums) {\n        unordered_map<int,bool>mp;\n        mp[nums[nums.size()-1]] = true;\n        \n        int i = 0;\n        for(i = nums.size()-1 ; i>0 ; i--){\n            if(mp.find(nums[i-1]) == mp.end())\n            {\n                mp[nums[i-1]] = true;\n            }\n            else break;\n        }\n        int ans = i / 3;\n        ans += i % 3 == 0 ? 0 : 1;\n        return ans;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"minimum-number-of-operations-to-have-distinct-elements","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1360}
